info.title: VoltFlow API
info.description: REST API for the VoltFlow electric scooter store. Public routes expose products and authentication. Protected routes use Laravel Sanctum Bearer tokens. Product management and dashboard endpoints require an administrator account.

get.description: Administrator only. Returns summary totals, order counts by status, and fourteen days of revenue data. Cancelled orders are excluded from revenue.
Administrator only. Returns users ordered by creation date, including each user's order count.

post.description: Creates an account with the user role and immediately issues a Laravel Sanctum token. The role field is prohibited.
Authenticates a user or administrator and issues a new Laravel Sanctum token.
Revokes the Laravel Sanctum token used for the current request.

get.description: Administrators receive all orders and may filter by user. Regular users receive only their own orders.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Administrators may filter by any user. A regular user may only submit their own ID.

403.description: Attempted access to another user's orders

post.description: Regular users only. Product prices, the total, the user ID, and the initial pending status are set by the backend. Stock is decremented atomically.

403.description: Only regular users may create orders

get.description: Administrators may view any order. Regular users may view only their own orders.

put.description: Only the status field is accepted. Users may cancel their own pending order. Administrator transitions: pending to processing or cancelled; processing to shipped or cancelled; shipped to delivered. Cancelling restores stock.

patch.description: Only the status field is accepted. Users may cancel their own pending order. Administrator transitions: pending to processing or cancelled; processing to shipped or cancelled; shipped to delivered. Cancelling restores stock.

get.description: Returns a public paginated product catalogue with search, price, stock, and sorting options.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Must be greater than or equal to min_price

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: True returns available products; false returns products with zero stock

post.description: Administrator only. The optional product image is stored on the public local disk.

put.description: Administrator only. All submitted fields are validated; fields may be updated partially. For reliable PHP multipart uploads, clients may send POST with a form field named _method set to PUT.

delete.description: Administrator only. A product referenced by any order item cannot be deleted.

patch.description: Administrator only. For reliable PHP multipart uploads, clients may send POST with a form field named _method set to PATCH, as the frontend does.

errors.description: Validation messages grouped by input field

orders_count.description: Included by the administrator user-list endpoint

description.example: A powerful urban electric scooter with a range of up to 60 km.

price.description: Decimal amount with two fractional digits

filters.description: Applied search, price, and stock filters

description.example: A lightweight electric scooter for city rides.

image.description: Optional JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 5 MB
Optional replacement JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 5 MB

revenue_over_time.description: Fourteen daily values; cancelled orders are excluded

bearerAuth.description: Enter the token returned by the register or login endpoint. Header format: Bearer {token}
